authoritative_cv_baseline.note: Current control baseline for the RL camera agent (track complex_b, Lane Cam, pure-pursuit). Supersedes the oval logical_cv_pd_controller arm below. RL-vs-CV head-to-head now CLOSED (2026-06-22) — see authoritative_rl_camera_complex_b_297k: the RL agent beats this CV baseline on tracking error.

runs.note: Clean live re-run with the PolylineTracker lap-seam fix in place. Confirmed against an offline re-derivation from the pre-fix logged pose (identical to 4 decimals). The pre-fix summary.json mis-scored complex_b as an open loop (1.68 m mean|ey| artifact).

authoritative_rl_camera_complex_b_297k.note: E-main camera policy (complex_b 297k peak). First nominal RL-vs-CV head-to-head on complex_b. Cage latent in-ODD (0 emergencies, only C-06 rate-limiter, no C-01/02/03/05); RL beats the CV baseline above on tracking error.

finding_complex_b: On complex_b (the harder, self-approaching circuit, perimeter 19.22 m) the camera RL agent BEATS the CV baseline on tracking: mean|ey| 10.9 mm (RL enforcement) vs 17.2 mm (CV), max 48.2 vs 57.3 mm, both 0 emergencies and the same distance (~94 m / 4.88 laps). This REVERSES the oval finding below (where the classical CV was more accurate): the pure-pursuit CV look-ahead degrades on tight self-approaching geometry while the CNN holds the line. Cost: the RL agent runs 43-46% C-06 rate-limiter (jerky CNN steering, benign) vs CV 0%; the cage stays latent in-ODD in both modes (no C-01/02/03/05, 0 emergencies) — the F-track signature, and the 139k curve-apex controlled stop is gone. Laps are not comparable across tracks (complex_b 19.22 m vs oval 8.79 m); the same-track CV row is the only fair lap comparison. CAVEAT: nominal only — the perturbation/degradation (GE4 campaign) head-to-head on 297k is not yet run.
_superseded_oval_comparison: The rl_camera_agent_425k and logical_cv_pd_controller arms below are the earlier OVAL eval (PD+curvature-FF CV law). Retained for history; superseded by authoritative_cv_baseline.
finding: Both pass the RL requirement (M-P1<50mm, max<d_max) with 0 emergencies and ~11 laps. In nominal the classical CV+PD baseline is slightly more accurate (RMSE 10.5 vs 14.2 mm, max 20.5 vs 56.7 mm) and far smoother (cage intervention 0.6-0.9% vs 82-86%: the RL CNN's jerky steering is continuously rate-limited by C-06). Nominal accuracy therefore does NOT favour the RL agent; its value must be demonstrated under perturbation/degradation where the CV estimator weakens — the robustness-world study.
